items.title: Canada dismantles TradeOgre exchange, seizes $40 million in crypto
items.description: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police has shut down the TradeOgre cryptocurrency exchange and seized more than $40 million believed to originate from criminal activities. [...]

items.title: Heathrow and Other European Airports Hit by Cyberattack, Several Flights Delayed
items.description: A major cyberattack on a popular aviation software provider has caused significant disruptions at key European airports, including London’s Heathrow, Brussels, and Berlin, resulting in hundreds of flight delays and cancellations on Saturday. The attack disabled electronic check-in and baggage drop systems, forcing airport staff to revert to manual processing and leaving thousands of passengers…
